item.subject: science
item.stem:
Meera's mother uses a shiny steel ladle in the kitchen. Meera looks at the inside of the ladle's bowl, where her face appears magnified and upright when she holds it close. The inside of the bowl is the reflecting surface, and it curves inwards like the inside of a spoon.
Which type of spherical mirror does this reflecting surface behave like?

options.A: a convex mirror, because the surface bulges outwards towards her face
options.B: a concave mirror, because the reflecting surface curves inwards
options.C: a plane mirror, because the steel surface is smooth and shiny
options.D: a convex mirror, because all shiny metal objects behave as convex mirrors
